mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (type, name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{type}, #{name}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET last_message_id = #{lastMessageId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE chat_id = #{chatId}
mapper.select: SELECT chat_id, type, name, last_message_id, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_room ORDER BY updated_at DESC
